record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.context_brief: connected metric CDH spaces not strongly 2-homogeneous
record.original_question: Does there exist a connected metrizable countable dense homogeneous space that is not strongly 2-homogeneous, where strongly 2-homogeneous means that any two ordered pairs of distinct points can be matched coordinatewise by a self-homeomorphism?

evidence.quote: The space X is strongly n-homogeneous if given two one-to-one sequences {ai : i < n}, {bi : i < n} of points in X both of length n, there is a homeomorphism h ∈ H (X) such that h(ai) = bi for every i < n.
He also presented an example of a connected CDH topological space which is not strongly 2-homogeneous and asked whether there is a metric example:
Problem 8 (van Mill [71]). Is there a connected CDH-space which is not strongly 2-homogeneous?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological space $X$ is called countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for any two countable dense subsets $D, E \subseteq X$ there exists a homeomorphism $h \colon X \to X$ with $h(D) = E$. The space $X$ is called strongly $2$-homogeneous if for any two ordered pairs $(a_0, a_1)$ and $(b_0, b_1)$ of distinct points of $X$ there exists a homeomorphism $h \colon X \to X$ with $h(a_0) = b_0$ and $h(a_1) = b_1$.

Does there exist a connected metrizable space $X$ that is countable dense homogeneous but not strongly $2$-homogeneous?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in surveys of open problems on countable dense homogeneity (van Mill and collaborators). A non-metric connected CDH example that is not strongly 2-homogeneous is known, but the metric version remains listed among open problems in recent surveys; no published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Topological Homogeneity (Arhangel'skii and van Mill)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys recent progress on CDH, including problems on strongly n-homogeneous CDH spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The metric version of the problem is listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity and topological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on CDH spaces still references open problems regarding strong n-homogeneity.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the metric connected CDH non-strongly-2-homogeneous problem is announced.
